reason.en: The FoodKeeper record places 2-3 months in the refrigerate column and leaves the freezer column empty. Two to three months is a freezer figure; no bread keeps that long on a fridge shelf, and publishing it in the fridge row would mislead anyone reading the table without the article.
reason.zh: FoodKeeper 這筆紀錄把 2–3 個月放在「冷藏」欄，而冷凍欄是空的。兩三個月是冷凍等級的期限，沒有任何麵包能在冷藏室放這麼久；照原樣刊在冷藏欄，只看表格不看內文的人就會被誤導。

evidence.en: The sibling record in the same dataset, 'Whole wheat bread, homemade', states 'Refrigeration not recommended - bread will quickly dry out and become stale' and puts 3 months under freezer. The two records describe the same storage behaviour, so the figure has been moved to the column it belongs in.
evidence.zh: 同一份資料集裡的「全麥麵包（自製）」寫著「不建議冷藏——麵包會迅速乾燥變硬」，並把 3 個月放在冷凍欄。兩筆紀錄描述的是同一種保存行為，因此我們把這個數字移到它該在的欄位。

base.tips: May have shorter shelf life due to lack of preservatives.
Refrigeration is not recommended: chilling stales lean bread faster than room temperature does, though it does hold off mould.
Wrap well and freeze on the day it is baked.

reason.en: The dataset carries two records for whole wheat flour and they disagree. One gives 3-6 months in the pantry and 6-8 months refrigerated after opening; the other gives 12 months in the pantry and 2 years refrigerated. Both cannot be right, and 12 months at room temperature is a white-flour figure: whole wheat keeps the oil-rich germ, and that oil is what turns rancid.
reason.zh: 這份資料集裡有兩筆全麥麵粉的紀錄，而且互相矛盾。一筆給常溫 3～6 個月、開封後冷藏 6～8 個月；另一筆給常溫 12 個月、冷藏 2 年。兩者不可能都對，而常溫 12 個月是白麵粉的數字：全麥保留了富含油脂的胚芽，會走油耗的正是那些油。

evidence.en: Ohio State University Extension's pantry storage guidance gives whole wheat flour 6 to 8 months and tells the reader to keep it refrigerated, which matches the first record and contradicts the second. This site publishes the first; the second record has been retired and its page redirects here.
evidence.zh: 美國俄亥俄州立大學推廣中心的常溫保存指引給全麥麵粉 6 到 8 個月，並要求冷藏保存——與第一筆相符，與第二筆矛盾。本站採用第一筆；第二筆已退役，其頁面轉址至此。

reason.en: Two records described the same root with different figures. The retired one gives 7 days in the pantry and 3 days refrigerated — a shorter life in the cold than at room temperature, which is the wrong way round for a root that is chilled precisely to slow its deterioration.
reason.zh: 兩筆紀錄描述同一種根莖，數字卻不同。被退役的那筆給常溫 7 天、冷藏 3 天——冷藏反而比常溫短，而低溫正是用來延緩木薯劣變的手段，這個方向是反的。

evidence.en: The figures published here come from USDA ARS Agriculture Handbook 66, the postharvest reference for commercial storage of fruits and vegetables, together with Hong Kong CFS guidance on cassava. Both are cited on the page itself.
evidence.zh: 本站採用的數字來自美國農業部農業研究署《農業手冊 66》——蔬果商業貯藏的採後權威參考——以及香港食物安全中心關於木薯的指引。兩者都列在該食材頁面上。

reason.en: Two records described the same bottles — Taiwanese rice wine, Shaoxing, huadiao and salted cooking wines. Neither carried a storage figure and both gave the same rule, so the site was answering one question on two pages.
reason.zh: 兩筆紀錄描述的是同樣的東西——台灣米酒、紹興、花雕與加鹽料理酒。兩筆都沒有保存期限數字，給的規則也一樣，等於同一個問題被拆成兩頁回答。

evidence.en: No figure changed: neither record published one. The two articles were merged into the surviving page, which keeps the alcohol thresholds and the names from both.
evidence.zh: 沒有任何數字被更動：兩筆本來就都沒有數字。兩篇文章已合併到留存的頁面，酒精濃度門檻與兩邊的品名都保留下來。

reason.en: Two records described the same berry, Physalis peruviana, under its Andean and its English name, and their figures were four times apart. The retired one gave 1-2 months at room temperature and 2-3 months refrigerated; the surviving one gives 1-2 weeks and 2-3 weeks. A fresh berry does not keep for a month on the counter.
reason.zh: 兩筆紀錄描述同一種漿果——祕魯苦蘵（Physalis peruviana）——只是一筆用安地斯名、一筆用英文名，而數字差了四倍。被退役的那筆給室溫 1～2 個月、冷藏 2～3 個月；留存的那筆給 1～2 週與 2～3 週。新鮮漿果不可能在檯面上放一個月。

evidence.en: Postharvest work on this fruit reports 24 days at 12 °C and 80% humidity with the calyx left on, and only 11 days once the calyx is removed. A kitchen is warmer than 12 °C, so the shorter figures are the ones a reader can rely on. That paper is now cited on the surviving page; note that its figures are the basis for retiring the longer record, not for the numbers themselves, which remain borrowed from apples and are disclosed as such.
evidence.zh: 這種水果的採後研究指出：帶果萼、12 °C、80% 濕度下為 24 天，果萼去除後只剩 11 天。廚房比 12 °C 熱，所以較短的那組數字才是讀者能依靠的。該論文已列在留存頁面的來源中；要說明的是，它是退役較長那筆紀錄的依據，而不是留存數字本身的出處——留存的數字仍然是比照蘋果而來，頁面上照常揭露。
